tooltip.vampiresdelight.spirit_lantern: Makes the player see a little farther in vampire fog while held.
tooltip.vampiresdelight.orchid_seeds: A vampiric species of terrestrial orchid that thrives in cursed or bloody soil. Flourishes fastest in the vampire fog. Direct sunlight stunts its growth; however, placing an opaque block above will help to keep it shaded.
tooltip.vampiresdelight.pourable_drink: To pour a drink into a glass, hold this bottle in one hand and a Glass Bottle in the other, then press and hold the right mouse button.
tooltip.vampiresdelight.daisy_tea:
Cures Weakness, Blindness,
Slowness, and Nausea
effect.vampiresdelight.fog_vision.descri: Extends visibility distance through vampire biome fog.
effect.vampiresdelight.consecration.desc: Banishes hostile unholy spirits (ghosts and phantoms by default) that target the affected entity. Cannot be applied to vampires.
effect.vampiresdelight.dissolving.descri: Gradually damages all worn armor. Leather, chainmail, and golden armor can break entirely.
enchantment.vampiresdelight.vampire_bite: Heals the player proportionally to the damage dealt.
advancement.vampiresdelight.root.desc: The haute cuisine of vampirekind awaits you!
advancement.vampiresdelight.consume_disg: Eat any disgusting food not intended for your faction.
advancement.vampiresdelight.pour_dandeli: Je savais que vous, les putains d'elfes, n'aviez aucun honneur! Pas de respect! Pas de BIÈRE!
Pour dandelion beer into a glass bottle using both hands, without a Crafting Table.
advancement.vampiresdelight.place_dandel: Il ne l'a pas brassé depuis...
Placez la bouteille de bière pissenlit sur une étagère à vin. C'est légal d'ailleurs.
advancement.vampiresdelight.get_garlic.d: Find Garlic in the wild or at a hunter trainer's house.
advancement.vampiresdelight.get_vampire_: Find a Vampire Orchid in a Vampire Forest, or buy it from a Wandering Trader.
advancement.vampiresdelight.plant_vampir: À la fois beauté et santé
Planter des graines d'Orchidée vampire sur des terres labourées corrompues ou sanglantes.
advancement.vampiresdelight.get_orchid_t: Brew some Orchid Tea. Drinking it can infect a human with Sanguinare. It can also be a little spicy.
advancement.vampiresdelight.bloody_rich_: Pour a Pure Blood Bottle on Rich Soil to obtain Bloody Soil.
advancement.vampiresdelight.pour_blood_w: Le vin de sang a le même goût que dans mes souvenirs
Pour blood wine into a glass bottle using both hands, without a Crafting Table.
advancement.vampiresdelight.place_blood_: Placez la bouteille de vin de sang sur une étagère à vin.
advancement.vampiresdelight.get_human_ey: Scavenge a Human Eye from any human-like creature, such as a Villager or Vampire Hunter, using a Knife.
subtitles.vampiresdelight.block.bottle_b: Une bouteille en verre se brise
gui.vampiresdelight.jei.info.human_eye:
Disgusting-looking ingredient for vampire food.

Obtained by cutting up villagers, pillagers, hunters, and some other human-like races.
gui.vampiresdelight.jei.info.black_mushr:
Black mushrooms are rarely found in vampire forests.

Bone Meal can be used to grow a huge variant.
gui.vampiresdelight.jei.info.wild_garlic: Garlic is commonly found as a wild plant in temperate lands, such as plains and forests.
